
## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

df_long4 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_by_explanation_for_R-Study3.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    feature_relevance = relevel(
      factor(feature_relevance),
      ref = "irrelevant"
    ),

    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("color", "feet"),
      labels = c("Color", "Feet")
    ),

    # Feature-specific explanation grouping:
    # classification can differ for the same participant across features
    feature_explanation_group = case_when(
      task == "predict" ~ "Predict",

      task == "accommodate" &
        had_causal_explanation_for_feature == TRUE ~
        "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)",

      task == "accommodate" &
        (
          had_causal_explanation_for_feature == FALSE |
          is.na(had_causal_explanation_for_feature)
        ) ~
        "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "Predict",
        "Accommodate\n(No Causal Explanation)",
        "Accommodate\n(Causal Explanation)"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
contrasts(df_long4$feature_explanation_group) <- contr.sum(3)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(2)

levels(df_long4$feature_explanation_group)

model_eff <- lmer(
  feature_importance ~ feature_explanation_group *
    feature_relevance *
    feature_dimension +
    (1 | participant),
  data = df_long4
)

summary(model_eff)

joint_tests(model_eff)
```
```{r}
joint_tests(model_eff)
```
```{r}
emm_task <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ task)
pairs(emm_task, adjust = "tukey")
```

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_relevance * task)
contrast(emm, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"), by = NULL, adjust = 'mvt')
```

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_dimension * feature_explanation_group)
contrast(emm, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"), by = NULL)
```

```{r}
# 1. Feature dimension, collapsed across relevance


plot_summary <- df_long4 |>
  filter(
    !is.na(feature_explanation_group),
    !is.na(feature_dimension),
    !is.na(feature_importance)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_importance = sd(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n_distinct(participant),
    se_importance = sd_importance / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  plot_summary,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = mean_importance,
    fill = feature_explanation_group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_importance - se_importance,
      ymax = mean_importance + se_importance
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = -0.5,
      label = n
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 2.5,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 7.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Mean feature importance",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

ggplot(
```

###PLOTTING: Correlations
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

df_long4 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_by_explanation_for_R-Study3.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    feature_relevance = relevel(
      factor(feature_relevance),
      ref = "irrelevant"
    ),

    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("color", "feet"),
      labels = c("Color", "Feet")
    ),

    # Group by: predict vs accommodate, with accommodate divided into explainer vs non explainer for a particular feature
    feature_explanation_group = case_when(
      task == "predict" ~ "Predictor",

      task == "accommodate" &
        had_causal_explanation_for_feature == TRUE ~ "Explainer",

      task == "accommodate" &
        (
          had_causal_explanation_for_feature == FALSE |
          is.na(had_causal_explanation_for_feature)
        ) ~ "Non-explainer",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c("Explainer", "Non-explainer", "Predictor")
    )
  )


plot_summary <- df_long4 |>
  filter(
    !is.na(feature_explanation_group),
    !is.na(feature_dimension),
    !is.na(feature_importance)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_importance = sd(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n_distinct(participant),
    se_importance = sd_importance / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_summary


ggplot(
  plot_summary,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = mean_importance,
    fill = feature_explanation_group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_importance - se_importance,
      ymax = mean_importance + se_importance
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = -0.5,
      label = paste0("n = ", n)
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 2.5,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 7.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Mean feature importance",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
model <- lmer(
  feature_importance ~
    feature_explanation_group * feature_relevance * feature_dimension +
    (1 | participant),
  data = df_long4
)
summary(model)
```
```{r}
emmeans(
  model,
  pairwise ~ feature_explanation_group | feature_dimension
)
```

```{r}
anova(model)
emm <- emmeans(model, ~ feature_explanation_group * feature_dimension)

contrast(
  emm,
  interaction = "pairwise",
  by = NULL
)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

df_corr4 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_by_explanation_for_R-Study3.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    feature_relevance = relevel(
      factor(feature_relevance),
      ref = "irrelevant"
    ),

    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("color", "feet"),
      labels = c("Color", "Feet")
    ),

    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "explainer",
        "non_explainer",
        "predictor"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Explainer",
        "Non-explainer",
        "Predictor"
      )
    )
  )


# Check participant counts in each group
df_corr4 |>
  count(
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  )


# Calculate means, SDs, SEs, and participant n
corr_plot_summary <- df_corr4 |>
  filter(
    !is.na(feature_explanation_group),
    !is.na(feature_dimension),
    !is.na(correlation)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_correlation = mean(
      correlation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sd_correlation = sd(
      correlation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n = n_distinct(participant),
    se_correlation = sd_correlation / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

corr_plot_summary


# Plot mean correlations by explanation group
ggplot(
  corr_plot_summary,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = mean_correlation,
    fill = feature_explanation_group
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_correlation - se_correlation,
      ymax = mean_correlation + se_correlation
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = -0.15,
      label = paste0("n = ", n)
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 2.5,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.25, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Mean correlation",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```


###ERROR

```{r}
df_merged <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_merged_for_R-Study3.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict"),

    color_relevance = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "color", "irrelevant", "relevant"),
    feet_relevance  = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "feet", "irrelevant", "relevant"),

    color_match_high = ifelse(color == color_high, 1, 0),
    feet_match_high  = ifelse(feet == feet_high, 1, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
df_cue <- df_merged |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      color_match_high,
      feet_match_high
    ),
    names_to = "feature_dimension",
    values_to = "match_high"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    feature_dimension = str_remove(
      feature_dimension,
      "_match_high"
    ),

    feature_relevance = case_when(
      feature_dimension == "color" ~ color_relevance,
      feature_dimension == "feet"  ~ feet_relevance
    ),

    # Did the accommodator explain this particular feature?
    explained_feature = case_when(
      feature_dimension == "color" ~ causal_color,
      feature_dimension == "feet"  ~ causal_feet
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    task,
    conditionOrder,
    relevant_dim,
    irrelevant_dim,
    feature_dimension,
    feature_relevance,
    explained_feature
  ) |>
  summarise(
    # Participant's inferred feature effect
    pred = mean(
      testing_responses[match_high == 1],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) -
      mean(
        testing_responses[match_high == 0],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    # True feature effect in the training environment
    true = mean(
      fertility_score[match_high == 1],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) -
      mean(
        fertility_score[match_high == 0],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    signed_error = pred - true,
    abs_error = abs(signed_error),

    feature_explanation_group = case_when(
      task == "predict" ~ "predictor",

      task == "accommodate" &
        explained_feature %in% TRUE ~ "explainer",

      task == "accommodate" ~ "non_explainer",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    task = relevel(
      factor(task),
      ref = "predict"
    ),

    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("color", "feet"),
      labels = c("Color", "Feet")
    ),

    feature_relevance = relevel(
      factor(feature_relevance),
      ref = "irrelevant"
    ),

    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "explainer",
        "non_explainer",
        "predictor"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Explainer",
        "Non-explainer",
        "Predictor"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
error_plot_summary <- df_cue |>
```
